What we fit

Maxus van wraps and signwriting.

Maxus vehicle graphics for businesses across Norwich and Norfolk, designed in-house and fitted at our workshop on St Faiths Road.

Maxus signwriting

Cut vinyl lettering for your name, services and contact details, placed around the doors, handles and panel lines of your Maxus. From £149 + VAT for a small van.

Maxus van wraps

Partial wraps over selected panels or a full wrap for maximum impact, printed in-house on quality cast film.

Maxus fleet graphics

One consistent livery adapted to every Maxus model you run, with fleet numbers and files kept on record.

Layout tip for Maxus vans

Large Deliver 9 panels suit bold fleet livery. On electric models we keep graphics clear of the charging flap.

Vehicle damaged?

We can organise panel repairs.

Graphics look their best on straight, sound panels, and vinyl cannot hide dents or rust. If your Maxus van needs some bodywork first, we can organise panel repairs as part of the service, so it comes back repaired and branded in one go.

  • Dents, scrapes and scuffed panels
  • Rust spots and chipped paint
  • Damaged bumpers and trims
Ask for details and a quote Send photos of the damage with your enquiry and we will include the repair in your quote.

Before you book

Maxus van graphics Norwich: your questions.

Do you do graphics for electric fleets?

Yes. We create one fleet design and adapt it to each electric and diesel model you run.

Do you fit graphics to all Maxus vans?

Yes. We fit signwriting, partial wraps and full wraps to Maxus vans, pickups and commercial vehicles, laid out on your exact model.

How much are Maxus van graphics in Norwich?

Signwriting starts from £149 for a small van, £210 for a medium van and £285 for a large van, fitted, all + VAT. Wraps are quoted per vehicle.
